Voter Pre-Registration Deadline- 2026 General Election
Chickasaw County Courthouse - Auditors Office
Voter Pre-Registration Deadline- 2026 General Election
October 19, 2026
Chickasaw County Courthouse - Auditors Office
Voter Pre-Registration Deadline
The deadlime to pre-register to vote for the General Election is 5:00 pm. This applies to registration in person (including registration at driver's license stations or agencies) or by mail. Voters may register online until 11:59p.m.
Exceptions: Mailed registration forms postmarked on or before 10/19/2026 are considered on time even if they are received after 5 p.m. today.
After today, a person may register to vote at the auditor's office and vote an absentee ballot. The process is the same as for registerin gto vote on election day.
Auditors office will be open until 5 p.m.

Chickasaw County Courthouse - Auditors Office
Public Testing of Voting Equipment – General Election
The Chickasaw County Auditor's Office will conduct public testing of voting equipment to verify that all voting systems are functioning properly and accurately recording votes prior to the November 3, 2026, General Election. The public is welcome to attend.

2026 GENERAL ELECTION DAY
Tuesday, November 3, 2026 – Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eligible registered voters may cast their ballot at their designated polling place. Voters who need to register or update their registration may do so at their polling place by providing proof of identity and proof of residence as required by Iowa law

Chickasaw County, Iowa
Located in northeast Iowa, Chickasaw County was established in 1851, named after the Chickasaw tribe, which then lived in the southern United States. It's home to nine cities and 12,012 residents.
The County is administered by a five-member Board of Supervisors who are elected for four-year terms. Other elected officials include the Attorney , Auditor , Recorder , Sheriff , and Treasurer .
